## ProofService.createRequestAsResponse() method

Create a [RequestPresentationMessage](./core.requestpresentationmessage.md) as response to a received presentation proposal. To create a request not bound to an existing presentation exchange, use [ProofService.createRequest()](./core.proofservice.createrequest.md)<!-- -->.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
createRequestAsResponse(proofRecord: ProofRecord, proofRequest: ProofRequest, config?: {
        comment?: string;
    }): Promise<ProofProtocolMsgReturnType<RequestPresentationMessage>>;
```

## Parameters

|  Parameter | Type | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
|  proofRecord | [ProofRecord](./core.proofrecord.md) | The proof record for which to create the presentation request |
|  proofRequest | [ProofRequest](./core.proofrequest.md) | The proof request to include in the message |
|  config | { comment?: string; } | <i>(Optional)</i> Additional configuration to use for the request |

Promise&lt;[ProofProtocolMsgReturnType](./core.proofprotocolmsgreturntype.md)<!-- -->&lt;[RequestPresentationMessage](./core.requestpresentationmessage.md)<!-- -->&gt;&gt;
